required.what: VDDRFPA and VDDANA must each be ≤ VDDRF
VDDSMPS and VDDRF must be the same supply as VDD; VDDA preferably tied to VDD
SMPS mode: 2.2 µH between VLXSMPS and VDD11, 4.7 µF on VDD11, 10 µF on VDDSMPS; LDO-only use: VDDSMPS and VLXSMPS to ground
Decoupling: n×100 nF + 10 µF on VDD; 100 nF + 1 µF on VDDA; 100 nF on VDDANA, VDDRFPA, VDDRF

HSE32 driven by an external clock on OSC_IN: 32 MHz, input level 0–0.9 V, amplitude 200–900 mVpp, duty 45–55 %, ±50 ppm (BLE); AC coupling 470 pF–100 nF supported — a full-swing CMOS oscillator needs attenuation
